version.body: 在本 Change 的 Claude Code 集成边界内，供应内容、实际 CLI 返回的可观察获取、执行者采用或异议声明、实际检查结果分别记录；开始或恢复任务时交付当前有效批准、适用约束和未决事项，保留原有版本依据。获取记录不证明理解，执行者声明不证明合规。
version.rationale: Apply the existing architecture evidence boundaries to this single-harness integration, without extending the archived pilot selector or granting work authorization through knowledge.

sources.content: Distinguish what Keepsail supplied, what observed retrieval/read operations returned, what the agent stated it adopted/rejected/challenged and why, and what result checks verified.
